entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Formed as an alliance of the national alliance party of kenya (nak) and the liberal democratic party (ldp) to contest the 2002 elections, collapsed due to disagreements between members over the 2005 constitutional referendum. Headquartered in Nairobi. Founded 2002. Dissolved 2016.
